Remark
[maximal zero components for commuting fields]

Source: petersen:page-0345 ↗ def:pet-ch8-symmetry-rank ↗ prop:pet-ch8-commuting-killing-fields-properties 1. ch8:8.4.16Let $(M,g)$ be a compact $n$-manifold with positive sectional curvature and $\mathfrak a\subset \iso $ an Abelian subalgebra. Let $\mathcal Z(\mathfrak a)$ be the set of nontrivial connected components of zero sets of Killing fields in $\mathfrak a$. Show that if $N\in \mathcal Z(\mathfrak a)$ is maximal under inclusion, then $\dim (\mathfrak a|_N)=\dim \mathfrak a-1$ and $\dim N\ge 2(\dim \mathfrak a-1)$.
